name: Proactive Agent
summary: Transform AI agents from task-followers into proactive partners that anticipate needs and continuously improve. Battle-tested patterns for agents that learn from every interaction and create value without being asked.

name: Remind Me

name: Stock Market Pro

name: Topic Monitor
